CoolAir Comfort Services
Customer Service Standard Operating Procedure
Effective Date: March 1, 2024 Document Owner: Customer Experience Team
1. Call Handling
All inbound service requests must be logged in the dispatch system within 5 minutes of the call ending. Customers should receive a confirmation text message with their appointment window within 15 minutes. 2. Escalation Path
Tier 1: Front-desk dispatcher handles scheduling, rescheduling, and general pricing questions. Tier 2: Customer Experience Lead handles billing disputes, refund requests, and warranty claim disputes.

2: Customer Experience Lead handles billing disputes, refund requests, and warranty claim disputes. Tier 3: Operations Manager handles complaints involving property damage or safety concerns. Must be looped in within 1 business hour. 3. Refund Policy
Refunds for disputed charges are processed within 7–10 business days once approved by the Customer Experience Lead. Refunds are issued to the original payment method. Cash payments are refunded via company check. 4.

Customers enrolled in the Annual Maintenance Plan receive two complimentary tune-up visits per year (spring and fall). These visits are logged as service orders with a $0.00 total_amount and should not be counted as revenue-generating jobs in performance reporting. 5. Data Handling
Customer contact information and service history are considered internal business records.
